text:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy `v2.4.1-rc3` -> prod:us-west-2. Change window 23:00-00:30 PT. Migrations queued: `schema.add_bot_settings`, `events.add_idx_userid`. Release notes: https://go/release/v2.4.1-rc3

maria: I'll start DB snapshot before migrations. kicking off backup now.

jon: noted, watching long jobs. If `events.add_idx_userid` goes >5m we should decide on partial-index fallback.

deploy-bot: migration `schema.add_bot_settings` started (mig-7421) on db-primary-007.

maria: mig-7421 progress: 0% -> 18% after ALTER TABLE add column; small lock for 2s. all good.

deploy-bot: migration `events.add_idx_userid` started (mig-7422) -- non-concurrent by default, estimate 12m.

kevin: heads-up: `events` is huge, this one usually causes replica lag. Plan B: create partial/concurrent index + swap. I vote for pinning edge/router while job runs.

sam: agreed, canary traffic reduced to 10% while we hold. I'll pin frontend to commit `abc1234` (router pin).

deploy-bot: mig-7422 observed replica lag and row-lock contention at 00:07 (7m). Pausing background copy to avoid cascading timeouts. Holding at 7m.

jon: if we can't get it to finish inside the change window, rollback plan B: revert service changes -> keep previous tag `v2.4.0` active and abort migration. We should prepare the revert now.

maria: snapshot complete: s3://rwdn-backups/1915304821.sql (sha256: f2b8...). Backup verified.

kevin: pin applied: router pinned to `abc1234` for 20m. Canary at 10% frozen. Notifying infra.

deploy-bot: Action: pin `v2.4.1-rc3` -> commit `abc1234` applied on router group. Canary hold confirmed.

sam: I've posted rollback steps to the ops runbook: https://go/runbooks/migration-rollback. If we abort, I'll cut the revert PR.

jon: agreed to give it 15 more minutes. If still blocking, we abort and revert.

deploy-bot: Resume approved by @jon. Resuming mig-7422 with concurrency tweaks (allow concurrent index build where possible).

maria: applying concurrent index strategy now: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_events_userid ON events(user_id) WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL;` will avoid long locks.

deploy-bot: mig-7422 resumed; background copy restarted. Estimated remaining ~6m.

kevin: monitoring replicas and read latency. No user-facing errors observed.

deploy-bot: migration `schema.add_bot_settings` finished (mig-7421) at 1915304920.

deploy-bot: migration `events.add_idx_userid` finished (mig-7422) at 1915304948. Index applied concurrently, replica lag normalized.

maria: pin removed: router unpinned, promoting `v2.4.1-rc3` to stable tag `v2.4.1`.

sam: canary released to full traffic. All services healthy in prod:us-west-2.

jon: thanks everyone. No rollback needed. I'll update the release notes with migration metrics and follow-up tasks. :tada: 

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: `v2.4.1` promoted. Logs: https://go/deploy/logs/1915304821.

kevin: leaving a quick postmortem note in #postmortems about index sizing and plan to automate concurrent-index fallback.

maria: closing the change window. good job team :thumbsup:
